text:
andrea (AE): quick sales pass — closing pilot with Asteria Health. They want private deployment (VPC) for PHI, SSO via Okta, and a 90-day pilot with a potential annual renewal. flagged renewal risk: budget exec sign-off delayed, could push by 30d. handing to CS for activation + enablement. key contacts: rachel@asteria, infra lead: marcus. notes: small prompt set for triage (~12 prompts), want low-latency for inference (p50 < 200ms).

jamal (CSM): thanks @andrea — grabbing this. main CS asks: 1) confirm infra window for private deploy, 2) SSO test creds, 3) run an enablement session for end-users (2x 1hr). assigning owners below.

andrea (AE): assigning owners — @jamal owns onboarding/runbook, @liam for eng/infra handoff, @tess for support/triage ops. I've uploaded the signed pilot contract to drive (link: https://redwood.internal/drive/asteria-pilot). :white_check_mark:

jamal (CSM): onboarding plan quick sketch: - Week 0: provisioning (VPC peering + KMS) - Week 1: SSO + account mapping - Week 2: perf validation + sample prompts - Week 3: enablement + go-live checklist. noting renewal touch: set reminder 30d before pilot end. tagging action items below.

liam (Eng oncall): quick infra notes: private deploy needs 2 GPU cards reserved for initial pilot, and a subnet with NAT for model pulls. ETA for infra tickets: 3 business days for capacity, 5 days if we need an on-prem appliance. Also need Okta metadata for SAML config. sample redirect/acs URL: `https://acera.redwood-corp/acs/saml`

andrea (AE): @liam — Marcus (customer infra) can be available Tue/Thu afternoons. Marcus prefers to share Okta metadata rather than live creds.

jamal (CSM): @tess can you create the support ticket and tag it high-priority for private deploy + SSO? include triage checklist and escalation path to eng.

tess (Support Lead): creating ticket now. ticket# RED-2028. summary: Asteria Health — private deploy + SSO, pilot activation. I'll add these labels: `private-deploy`, `sso`, `pilot`, `renewal-watch`. Can you drop sample prompts and expected perf numbers in the ticket so support can run smoke tests?

andrea (AE): adding example prompt set in thread: - "Summarize patient visit notes" - "Extract medication changes" - "Identify follow-up needs". expected token size ~120 tokens per prompt.

jamal (CSM): capturing owners and dates: - Provisioning (liam) due 2026-04-01 - SSO test creds/metadata (customer) due 2026-03-29 - Perf validation (jamal + liam) due 2026-04-05 - Enablement session (jamal) schedule by 2026-04-07. Renewal check-in scheduled 30 days before pilot end (reminder set).

triage-bot: Ticket RED-2028 created and assigned to @tess, watchers: @jamal, @liam. SLA: P1 if production blocked.

liam (Eng oncall): noted. I'll open infra tickets: INF-847 (capacity) and INF-848 (network). linking both to RED-2028. if network needs a route, please share customer CIDR.

jamal (CSM): thanks all. last ask: @andrea can you drop the procurement contact so our renewal outreach has context? also capturing feedback loop: we'll run a 2-week survey during pilot and capture NPS + prompt quality notes.

andrea (AE): procurement is nina@asteria. i'll intro on email after this thread. good luck team :rocket:
